release_notes:
1. Redesigned Events Management Interface: Reorganized columns (STATUS, EVENT, CATEGORY, DESCRIPTION, DESTINATIONS, ACTIONS), category pills, and destination summary pills with tooltip breakdown.
2. Slide-Out Inspect Drawer: Replaced modal dialog with modern right-side drawer featuring prefixed event code with copy, authoritative details, live destination routing quick-toggles, full parameter specifications, and platform tracking code blocks.
3. Simplified Filter Toolbar: Labeled bulk action buttons ([Enable All] and [Disable All]) separated from category pills and status filter.
4. Unsaved Changes Tracking: Real-time visual indicator and save progress feedback with double-submit prevention.
5. Event Active State Persistence: Fully backed by backend PS_GTM_ACTIVE_EVENTS configuration key.
